detaileddescription.para: Provides reproducible latency measurements for the maintenance module hot paths identified in the maintenance module roadmap (Phase 5 — Performance and Hardening).

sect2.title: Benchmark families
sect2.para: Measures the cost of casting MaintenanceError values from int32_t; serves as a baseline for error-path hot loops.
Measures switch-based dispatch across all MaintenanceError codes; validates that the compiler optimises the switch into an O(1) jump table.
Measures in-process heap allocation and initialisation cost for MaintenanceScheduleDescriptor; release gate for schedule-churn paths.
Measures amortised error-cast cost across a batch of 1 000 mixed codes; simulates a high-churn schedule-validation hot loop.

sect2.title: Hard release gates
sect2.para: All benchmarks use kCanonicalSeed = 42 for deterministic inputs.
